title: Deeper In
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A little stream came trickling out
Beneath the temple door;
And everywhere the water went,
It grew a little more.

[Chorus]
Then ankles, knees, and waist, and more,
The river rising high;
His goodness grows the farther in
We walk with Him nearby.

[Verse 2]
And where it ran, the fish swam free,
And trees grew green and tall;
With fruit to eat and leaves to heal,
The river blessed them all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Scout waded in the lake in boots,
He looked back with a grin;
His dad held out a steady hand,
And they went deeper in.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So wiggle toes and take a step,
And look for one good thing;
His goodness grows like that small stream,
And makes the desert sing.

[Chorus]
mood: Wading music. A light, rippling harp pattern that starts with only a few notes, like a trickle over stones, and gains one more voice each verse as the water rises: the cello comes in low at the knees, a second harp line at the waist. Always moving forward in a gentle walking step, curious and bright, and the last chorus opens wide and clear like a river in morning sun, never louder.
